registered_before: any score of the gate on LID-DS 2021 or CB-DS; the simulation below uses trials of pulse-live-v4-1109 only
owner_decision: 09/11: the project centres on the ML; tree and support are dropped from the alert path for now but kept: code, models and thresholds stay, the branches are computed and logged in shadow
system: the token branch alone. The three-branch system stays only as the reference that reproduces lidds-ml-v4 before any candidate is read

phase_threshold.why: the exec hold is a hand-written rule; a threshold of its own for the phase after an execve is learnt from data and still lets a very surprising launch alarm. Simulation on 133 attack, 136 benign, 132 control trials (results-20261109/benign-burden-research/phase.py): phase 30 and outside 14 gives benign 2/136, primary 69/69, all rates 99/133; hold 1 s and outside 14 gives 2/136, 68/69, 92/133. These values were read with labels, so they only show the direction
phase_threshold.rule: a token alarm needs the window's pool score above the phase threshold when the window lies within the phase seconds after the last execve, and above the pool threshold otherwise
phase_threshold.cluster_fit: moment Gumbel without the top 1 % on the maximum pool score within the phase of each benign launch of pulse-live-v4-1109 (benign binary intervals only; no attack data), one threshold for the cluster, at the candidate's pool level. Normal idle windows cannot set it (their maximum in the phase is 11.2)
phase_threshold.dataset_fit: the datasets have no benign launch through a runtime, so the same fit runs on the maxima within the phase of each validation and training recording holding an execve; with fewer than 3 such recordings the pool threshold applies

candidates: token system only: hold candidates of the protocol, and phase candidates at phase seconds 1 and 2 with pool levels 0.01, 0.001, 0.00018. The hold remains a candidate because it is the simpler comparison; when it is chosen, results with and without it are reported as a rule, apart from the ML
selection_order: unchanged, except that at equal step 2 outcomes a phase candidate goes before a hold candidate, because the project centres on the ML
limits: the phase threshold of the cluster is fitted on launches of the benign binary, so the benign binary is not blind in the next live run; the admin commands are
